Description: End-to-end capture of lost and found listings with automated tag generation.
Intelligent geo-proximity matching and anti-fraud proof of ownership verification.
Administrative workflows for report approval rejection and dispute handling.

Summary: US-01: Create Lost and Found Reports
Description: As a Finder or Owner, I want to log a detailed Lost or Found item report with item characteristics, date, location, and optional photos, so that the item is catalogued on the network for matching.
As a System or User, I want the system to extract keywords, category, colour, and visual attributes automatically, so that reports are indexed accurately without requiring manual exhaustive tagging.
As a Lost Item Owner, I want the system to match my report against active Found items within a defined geographical radius, so that I am promptly alerted to high-probability matches.

Summary: US-04: Proof of Ownership Security Verification
Description: As an Item Finder, I want claimants to answer private security questions set by me before handover details are displayed, so that fraudulent claims are prevented and privacy is protected.
As a Community Administrator, I want an admin console to review, approve, reject reports, and arbitrate contested claims, so that the network remains safe, accurate, and free of spam.
